description:
Anchor Roma 20A modular switch by Panasonic - the most widely installed modular switch series in India. The 20A variant handles heavy loads like geysers, ACs, and room heaters. Silver alloy contacts ensure spark-free operation. The polycarbonate housing is self-extinguishing (V0 rated). Available in white and black front plates.

Technical note: Wiring requires 4 sq mm copper wire for full 20A load. Use with Anchor Roma 20A socket (Cat No. 66202) for complete point.
price_reasoning: Anchor distributor ₹82 (trade price for 100+ pieces), Amazon ₹95 (MRP for single), IndustryBuying ₹78 (bulk 500+). Used distributor trade price as typical B2B scenario.
manufacturer_info: Anchor Electricals (now Panasonic Life Solutions India) was acquired by Panasonic in 2007. Originally founded in 1963, it pioneered modular switches in India. 5 manufacturing plants.
pros: Most trusted switch brand in India
cons: Premium priced vs Chinese modular switches
Roma design is dated vs Havells/Legrand aesthetic
